body:
The arc42 architecture docs predate ADR-0023 and describe Ubuntu 26.04 as the only system, built in.

- **05 Building block view:** add the target folder (`targets/<id>/`) as a building block and show what reads it (REPL start-up, gate, installer, pipeline). The "Reference VM and harvest" row becomes per target.
- **07 Deployment view:** weights are downloaded at install and verified against the target's `model.toml` SHA-256; the package ships the runtime files of every target; the personalization adapter is tied to the base-weight hash. Keep the existing **[OPEN]** on the weight distribution channel, now as "the URL host in `model.toml`".
- **08 Cross-cutting concepts:** §8.8 "Ubuntu 26.04 specifics" becomes the `ubuntu-26.04` target's specifics; "dpkg-owned" wording (local-reference, reader output) becomes "package-owned (the target's query)".

**Done when:** 05, 07 and 08 match ADR-0023 and spec `policy-gate/v1`, and no architecture doc describes an OS-specific detail as global.
